project.name: CreditIntel
project.description: Full-stack loan management and risk assessment system: FastAPI backend, React frontend, PostgreSQL, LightGBM risk model + LR scorecard, LangChain RAG chatbot (Qdrant + OpenRouter), ETL pipeline on DuckDB over Home Credit dataset.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Repository conventions: project structure, build/test/dev commands, coding style, naming conventions, testing guidelines, commit and PR guidelines, and security tips.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Main project documentation (Vietnamese) with system architecture diagrams, RAG pipeline detail, ETL & ML architecture, full directory tree, quick-start guide, and technology table.

nodes.name: Backend (FastAPI)
nodes.summary: FastAPI API server with routers, services, models, schemas, core, db, and rag submodules. Entry point main.py, runs on http://localhost:8000.

nodes.name: Frontend (React + Vite)
nodes.summary: React 18 + Vite + TailwindCSS SPA with customer and admin role pages, Axios API client, Zustand auth state, and mock mode for offline development.

nodes.name: Machine Learning & ETL
nodes.summary: Offline Bronze→Silver→Gold ETL pipeline on DuckDB and ML training scripts for LightGBM risk model and LR scorecard. Artifacts (.pkl) consumed by backend services at runtime.

nodes.name: Loan Application State Machine
nodes.summary: DRAFT→submit→ML predict→if prob>0.4: AUTO_REJECTED else PENDING_REVIEW. Admin: PENDING_REVIEW→AWAITING_INFO or REJECTED. Customer responds→APPROVED.

nodes.name: RAG Chat Pipeline
nodes.summary: LangChain RAG: Guardrail→Router→Rewriter→Hybrid Retrieve (Qdrant dense+BM25)→Reranker→Parent Expand→Prompt→LLM (Gemini 2.5 Flash)→Guardrail→Persist.

nodes.name: Chapter 3: Data, ETL & Credit Risk Analysis
nodes.summary: Vietnamese report chapter covering the Medallion Architecture ETL pipeline, Home Credit dataset (138 Parquet files, ~27GB, 6 tables), DuckDB design, feature engineering for LightGBM and LR scorecard, and challenges of missing values and class imbalance (3.14% default rate).

nodes.name: Chapter 5: RAG & AI Credit Assistant
nodes.summary: Vietnamese report chapter detailing the RAG architecture: hybrid search (dense + BM25), cross-encoder reranking with Jina, parent-child chunking, personalized context assembly, and the 6-step LangChain pipeline using Qdrant and OpenRouter.

nodes.name: CIC Bureau Integration Changelog
nodes.summary: Technical changelog for CIC (Credit Information Center) integration across four phases: auto-enrichment overwriting self-reported data with bureau records, blacklist enforcement, synthetic data ecosystem, frontend CIC verification badges.

nodes.name: Migration v2: Credit Risk Model Stability Dataset
nodes.summary: Documents migration from Home Credit Default Risk 2018 to Credit Risk Model Stability 2024 dataset, removing gameable credit_score feature, adding 10+ behavioral features, achieving LightGBM v4 ROC-AUC 0.8065 on 1.5M records.

nodes.name: Credit Score Implementation Plan
nodes.summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for the FICO-style credit scoring system (300-850): LR scorecard training, ml_service fix, new API endpoint, SHAP explainability, gold SQL behavioral features, and frontend dashboard. Checkbox-based task tracking with TDD.

nodes.name: CIC Feature Gap Analysis
nodes.summary: Gap analysis comparing LightGBM v4 (35 features) and LR Scorecard (30 features) against the cic_credit_records bureau schema, classifying each feature as directly mapped, approximated, missing, or unrelated.

nodes.name: ML Features & Training Results
nodes.summary: Documents 28-35 features used in the LightGBM risk model v4, sanity override logic for OOD inputs, training metrics (ROC-AUC 0.8065), default rate analysis by occupation and DTI bands.

nodes.name: LR Scorecard Features & Results
nodes.summary: Documents 25-30 features of LR Scorecard v3, FICO PDO formula parameters, score distribution analysis (99.92% in 500-669 range for v2), LR coefficient table by feature group, training results ROC-AUC 0.7367.

nodes.name: Model Features Reference (Vietnamese)
nodes.summary: Bilingual reference table comparing all 35 LightGBM v4 and 30 LR Scorecard features side-by-side with data source, input format, units, and alias mappings. Note: monetary fields use Home Credit dataset units, not VND.

nodes.name: Scorecard Calculation Detail
nodes.summary: Deep technical reference for LR Scorecard v2 math: sigmoid/logit derivation, FICO PDO scaling formula with full coefficient table (30 features, intercept -2.6539), points breakdown decomposition, raw-value-to-points lookup formula.

nodes.name: Scorecard Training Detail
nodes.summary: Technical training guide for LR Scorecard v2: directory I/O map, data validation, sklearn Pipeline architecture (StandardScaler + OrdinalEncoder + LogisticRegression C=0.1), and FICO scaling engine implementation.

nodes.name: SHAP Explainability
nodes.summary: Technical guide for SHAP-based model explainability: Shapley value theory, mathematical equivalence between SHAP values and FICO scorecard points, LinearExplainer integration in credit_score_service.py for adverse action reasons.

nodes.name: Admin Guide
nodes.summary: Admin Portal operation guide covering Mock Persistence Engine, test accounts, Dashboard KPIs, loan management workflow (approve/reject/request-info), E2E testing scenarios, and admin frontend directory structure.

nodes.name: Modules and Files
nodes.summary: Describes each module, file, and folder in CreditIntel project. Covers root files, ML config/data/database layers, docs, ML scripts and pkl artifacts, and links between ETL layers and backend services.

nodes.name: Project Overview
nodes.summary: CreditIntel system overview: ETL pipeline (Bronze→Silver→Core→Gold), risk dashboard, AI prediction (LightGBM + LR Scorecard), database management, and technology stack (Python, FastAPI, React, LightGBM, scikit-learn, PostgreSQL).

nodes.name: Current Project Structure
nodes.summary: Current directory tree of CreditIntel with full backend/ (FastAPI routers, services, models, schemas, RAG), frontend/src/ (components, pages, store, mocks), machinelearning/ (etl, database, ml), RAG_eval/, and docs/ with per-file annotations.

nodes.name: Data ETL & ML Flow
nodes.summary: Deep technical analysis of the full data lifecycle: Kaggle Parquet→Bronze→Silver→Gold (hc_features_v2)→ML training (LightGBM & LR Scorecard)→FastAPI inference. Includes Mermaid diagrams, class imbalance analysis, currency unit warnings, and per-layer ETL details.

nodes.name: overall.md
nodes.summary: System overview (2026-05-13): two parallel data branches (Prosper + Home Credit), 4-layer ASCII architecture, two ML models (LightGBM + LR Scorecard), RAG Chatbot (LangChain + Pinecone), React frontend, directory structure, and API endpoints table.

nodes.name: RAG Report (Sections 1-3)
nodes.summary: Academic report on the RAG system in CreditIntel covering rationale (anti-hallucination), backend/rag/ module scope, tech stack (LangChain, Qdrant, OpenRouter Gemini 2.5 Flash), RAG theory (Lewis et al. 2020), hybrid search, cross-encoder reranking, parent-child chunking, and 6-step pipeline.

nodes.name: RAG Report Outline
nodes.summary: 10-section outline for the academic RAG report: Introduction→Theory→Architecture→Ingest→Runtime pipeline→Knowledge sources→Advanced techniques→Evaluation→Limitations→Conclusion. Includes component-to-source-file mapping table.

nodes.name: RAG Report (Sections 4-5)
nodes.summary: Academic RAG report sections 4-5: Ingest stage and Runtime pipeline. Section 4 details the 5-step Parent-Child Chunking algorithm (metadata, parent splitting by heading/FAQ, child splitting 700 chars/80 overlap, stable SHA-1 IDs).

nodes.name: RAG Chatbot Plan
nodes.summary: Comprehensive design document for the CreditIntel RAG chatbot: tech stack, architecture, knowledge base ingestion, API contract, PostgreSQL schema, Vietnamese system prompt, phased deployment checklist, security measures, and cost estimates.

nodes.name: RAG ML Context Requirements
nodes.summary: Requirements for ML and form context the RAG chatbot needs for personalized loan advisory. Defines four context groups: form fields, ML prediction, advisory context, and loan package catalog.

nodes.name: RAG System Overview
nodes.summary: Up-to-date architectural overview of the production multi-stage RAG pipeline: 6-step chain, hybrid retrieval (dense+BM25), cross-encoder reranking, personalizer, loan adjustment state machine, memory, and evaluation framework.

nodes.name: RAG KB Chunking V1 Plan
nodes.summary: Replace fixed-size KB chunking with Markdown/FAQ-aware semantic chunks and parent-document retrieval. Introduces rag.chunking module; modifies ingest.py, retriever.py, chain.py.

nodes.name: RAG Memory V1 Plan
nodes.summary: Replace dead memory.py and inline history fetch with token-aware sliding window plus lazy summary-buffer memory per session. Adds summary columns to ChatSession.

nodes.name: RAG Resilience Fixes Plan
nodes.summary: Fix 5 resilience gaps: exception hierarchy (RAGError), configurable timeouts, atomic save for chat messages, personalizer DB deduplication, and ingest CLI argparse flags.

nodes.name: Backend Quality Hardening Plan
nodes.summary: Fix 6 non-RAG quality issues: React Router /history route ordering, datetime conventions, CORS with allow_origins=*, mid-file imports, shallow /health, and missing test coverage.

nodes.name: RAG Code Review
nodes.summary: Comprehensive code review of backend/rag/ module (18 files) plus chat_service integration. Documents bugs (bad __init__.py exports, context_builder credit_score band, datetime.utcnow) and optimizations.

nodes.name: RAG Eval + Memory V1.1 Polish Plan
nodes.summary: Apply 6 targeted fixes from eval framework and memory V1.1 audit: baseline UX, missing test coverage, FAQ-07 phrase adjustment.

nodes.name: RAG Eval Framework V1 Plan
nodes.summary: Build lightweight RAG evaluation framework: 31-case ground-truth dataset, faithfulness and context-precision metrics, baseline diff reporting. Introduces eval_metrics.py, eval_runner.py.

nodes.name: RAG KB Chunking V1.1 Fix Plan
nodes.summary: Fix 3 chunking V1 defects: heading hierarchy flattening (Critical), FAQ preamble drop, and missing --recreate migration note.

nodes.name: RAG Loan Adjustment Tool Plan
nodes.summary: Propose safer loan terms after AUTO_REJECTED via loan_adjustment_tool.py. Adds ChatSession.pending_action JSON column; creates application_service.confirm() triggered by user confirmation keywords.

nodes.name: RAG Hybrid Retrieval V1 Plan
nodes.summary: Swap pure dense retrieval for Qdrant native hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vector, RRF fusion) using fastembed sparse encoder. Requires re-ingestion with --recreate.

nodes.name: RAG Rerank V1.1 Follow-up Plan
nodes.summary: Run controlled reranker V1.1 experiments: configurable rag_reranker_top_k, three candidate-k/top-k combinations. Only update defaults if variant beats Stage 2 baseline.

nodes.name: RAG Cross-Encoder Reranker V1 Plan
nodes.summary: Insert cross-encoder reranker (jina-reranker-v2-base-multilingual) between hybrid retrieval and parent expansion: top-20→top-12→top-4. New reranker.py singleton with graceful fallback and rag_reranker_enabled toggle.

nodes.name: RAG Query Rewriting Plan
nodes.summary: Add conversation-aware query rewriting so follow-up questions retrieve documents using a standalone rewritten query. Creates rag/query_rewriter.py wired into chain.invoke() for retrieval-needed intents.

nodes.name: Loan Adjustment Soft Rule Plan
nodes.summary: Let LLM reason about loan adjustment parameters via soft-propose/hard-verify architecture. New loan_adjustment_reasoner.py proposes (amount, term) candidates; merged with hard grid, all verified by ml_service.predict, then ranked. LLM failure degrades to pure hard grid.

nodes.name: RAG KB Chunking V1 Design Spec
nodes.summary: Design spec for structure-aware semantic chunking: Markdown heading and FAQ-aware parent-child chunk pairs. Introduces backend/rag/chunking.py with rich metadata (source_type, document_title, section_title, parent_id, chunk_index).

nodes.name: RAG Memory V1 Design Spec
nodes.summary: Design spec for token-aware sliding window plus lazy summary-buffer memory. MemoryContext dataclass, load_memory() with lazy summarization, persists summary to chat_sessions.summary.

nodes.name: RAG Memory V1.1 Fixes Design
nodes.summary: Post-audit fix spec: user message duplication fix (exclude_message_id), error-row exclusion test coverage, SQLAlchemyError graceful degradation in _summarize.

nodes.name: RAG Resilience Fixes Design Spec
nodes.summary: Design spec hardening RAG pipeline resilience: typed RAGError exception hierarchy, configurable timeouts with tenacity retry, atomic chat message save, personalizer deduplication, ingest --dry-run/--recreate CLI flags.

nodes.name: RAG Eval + Memory Polish Design
nodes.summary: Polish spec: missing-baseline-file UX fix, run-level regression threshold test, --quiet flag behavior, and further memory test coverage gaps.

nodes.name: RAG Eval Framework V1 Design Spec
nodes.summary: Design spec for lightweight deterministic RAG evaluation: 31-case ground-truth dataset with must_include/must_not_include, faithfulness and context_precision metrics, baseline diff per case for regression detection.

nodes.name: RAG KB Chunking V1.1 Fixes Design
nodes.summary: Post-audit fix spec: heading hierarchy flattening (# as document_title, ## as section boundary), FAQ preamble preservation, --recreate migration note addition.

nodes.name: RAG Loan Adjustment Tool V1 Design Spec
nodes.summary: Design spec for chatbot-driven loan re-application: loan_adjustment_tool.find_best_reapplication_option, pending_action JSON blob on ChatSession, application_service.confirm() triggered by user confirmation.

nodes.name: RAG Hybrid Retrieval V1 Design Spec
nodes.summary: Stage 1 design: Qdrant native hybrid search (BM25 + dense, RRF k=60). Adds fastembed>=0.3.0, rag_bm25_model setting. Measured with V1 eval framework on 31 cases.

nodes.name: RAG Reranker V1 Design Spec
nodes.summary: Stage 2 design: cross-encoder reranker (jina-reranker-v2-base-multilingual via fastembed). top-20 candidates→top-12→top-4 parents. Singleton lazy-loaded cache, rag_reranker_enabled toggle, graceful fallback.

nodes.name: RAG Rerank V1.1 Follow-up Design
nodes.summary: Investigation spec for FAQ-03 regression after reranker. Three experiments: candidate/top-k sensitivity, source-type diversity constraint, lighter model fallback. Conclusion: no variant beat Stage 2 defaults.

nodes.name: RAG Query Rewriting Design Spec
nodes.summary: Stage 3 design: rewrite_for_retrieval() using OpenRouter to expand follow-up questions into standalone queries. Used only for Qdrant search; original message preserved for LLM prompt. Skips greetings/off-topic.

nodes.name: Loan Adjustment Soft Rule Design Spec
nodes.summary: Design spec (implemented 2026-06-03): LLM-guided soft proposals merged with hard-grid candidates. New loan_adjustment_reasoner.py. Three invariants: ML is final judge, worst-case equals current behavior, output contract unchanged.

nodes.name: frontend/.env.mock
nodes.summary: Frontend mock mode environment config. Sets VITE_MOCK=true to activate MSW service workers instead of real backend API calls.

nodes.summary: Customer-facing frontend documentation: loan application flow, chat UI conventions, form validation rules, and UX guidelines for the customer portal pages.

nodes.name: frontend/README.md
nodes.summary: Frontend setup and development guide: npm scripts (dev, mock, build, preview), directory structure (pages, components, services, store, mocks), and Vite configuration notes.

nodes.summary: Frontend coding rules: component patterns, Tailwind utility conventions, Zustand store usage, API call rules (all via services/api.js), mock mode patterns, and naming conventions.

nodes.name: frontend/index.html
nodes.summary: Vite SPA entry HTML. Mounts React app to #root, loads src/main.jsx. Sets page title to CreditIntel.

nodes.name: frontend/package.json
nodes.summary: Frontend Node.js manifest for creditintel-frontend v1.0.0. Dependencies: React 18, axios, zustand, react-router-dom, react-hook-form, recharts, react-markdown. DevDeps: Vite 5, Tailwind 3, TypeScript types.

nodes.name: transform_gold_hcv2.sql
nodes.summary: Gold layer SQL transform. Reads silver.hc_v2_cleansed, computes 35 ML features: income/loan ratios, log transforms, DTI bands, bureau aggregates, behavioral flags (high_dti, bad_debt, income_verifiable). Writes to gold.hc_features_v2. No self-reported credit_score — all verifiable/behavioral features.

nodes.name: transform_gold_homecredit.sql
nodes.summary: Legacy gold layer SQL transform for the original Home Credit 2018 dataset. Reads silver.hc_cleansed, writes to gold.hc_features. Superseded by transform_gold_hcv2.sql after the 2024 dataset migration.

nodes.name: transform_silver_hcv2.sql
nodes.summary: Silver layer SQL transform for Home Credit v2. Joins 6 bronze tables (train_base, train_static_0, train_static_cb_0, train_person_1, train_credit_bureau_a_1, train_applprev_1) into flat silver.hc_v2_cleansed with imputation and type casting.

nodes.name: transform_silver_homecredit.sql
nodes.summary: Legacy silver layer SQL transform for Home Credit 2018 dataset. Joins original bronze tables into silver.hc_cleansed. Superseded by transform_silver_hcv2.sql after the 2024 dataset migration.

nodes.name: backend/main.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI application entry point. Creates app, configures CORS (allow_origins=["*"]), mounts 6 routers (/auth, /applications, /admin, /chat, /credit-score, /cic). Startup event pre-warms the reranker singleton. Exposes /health endpoint.

nodes.name: backend/core/config.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic BaseSettings that reads backend/.env. Provides DB connection params (DB_HOST, DB_PORT, DB_NAME, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD), JWT settings (SECRET_KEY, ALGORITHM, ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES), OpenRouter API key, RAG settings (LLM model, embedding model, reranker toggle), and Qdrant connection (URL, API key, collection).

nodes.name: backend/core/security.py
nodes.summary: JWT token creation and bcrypt password hashing/verification utilities. Used by auth_service for login and registration.

nodes.name: backend/core/scoring.py
nodes.summary: Risk-level cutoff constants derived from the ML model artifact thresholds. Maps default_probability ranges to risk labels (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH).

nodes.name: backend/db/session.py
nodes.summary: SQLAlchemy engine and SessionLocal factory. Provides get_db() FastAPI dependency that yields a DB session and closes it after each request.

nodes.name: backend/db/init_app.sql
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL DDL: creates users (UUID PK, role enum), loan_applications (UUID PK, foreign key to users, status enum with DRAFT/PENDING_REVIEW/AUTO_REJECTED/APPROVED/REJECTED/AWAITING_INFO, JSONB feature_snapshot/imputed_features, ML output columns: default_probability, risk_level, risk_score), personal_info, chat_sessions, chat_messages tables.

nodes.name: backend/init_db.py
nodes.summary: Database initialization script. Reads init_app.sql and executes it against the configured PostgreSQL database. Run once to create/migrate DB tables (python init_db.py from backend/).

nodes.name: backend/api/dependencies.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI dependency functions: get_current_user() decodes JWT token, get_admin_user() enforces admin role. Used by routers to protect endpoints.

nodes.name: backend/api/routers/auth.py
nodes.summary: Auth router (/auth). Thin handlers for POST /register (calls auth_service.register), POST /login (calls auth_service.login returning JWT), GET /me (returns current user profile).

nodes.name: backend/api/routers/applications.py
nodes.summary: Applications router (/applications). Customer-facing endpoints: POST / (submit loan app, triggers ML predict, sets AUTO_REJECTED or PENDING_REVIEW), GET / (list own apps), GET /{id} (detail), PATCH /{id} (update draft), POST /{id}/confirm (confirm pending action from loan adjustment tool).

nodes.name: backend/api/routers/admin.py
nodes.summary: Admin router (/admin). Protected endpoints requiring admin role: GET /applications (list all with filters), GET /applications/{id} (detail + ML scores), PATCH /applications/{id}/status (approve/reject/request-info transitions), GET /stats (dashboard metrics).

nodes.name: backend/api/routers/chat.py
nodes.summary: Chat router (/chat). POST /sessions/{app_id}/messages sends user message through RAG pipeline (rate-limit ≤20/min, triggers chat_service.send_message). GET /sessions/{app_id}/messages returns conversation history.

nodes.name: backend/api/routers/credit_score.py
nodes.summary: Credit score router (/credit-score). GET /me returns FICO-style scorecard score (300-850) for current user's most recent application via credit_score_service.

nodes.name: backend/api/routers/cic.py
nodes.summary: CIC (Credit Information Center) router (/cic). Endpoints for registering and retrieving CIC bureau data linked to loan applications.

nodes.name: backend/models/application.py
nodes.summary: SQLAlchemy ORM model for LoanApplication. Columns: id (UUID), user_id (FK to users), status (enum: DRAFT/PENDING_REVIEW/AUTO_REJECTED/APPROVED/REJECTED/AWAITING_INFO), feature_snapshot (JSONB), imputed_features (JSONB), default_probability (float), risk_level (str), risk_score (float), terms (JSONB), created_at, updated_at.

nodes.name: backend/models/chat.py
nodes.summary: SQLAlchemy ORM models for ChatSession and ChatMessage. ChatSession has pending_action (JSONB for loan adjustment) and summary (text for lazy summarization). ChatMessage stores role, content, error flag, created_at.

nodes.name: backend/models/base.py
nodes.summary: SQLAlchemy declarative Base class. All ORM models inherit from this.

nodes.name: backend/api/__init__.py
nodes.summary: API package init. Empty or minimal re-exports.

nodes.name: backend/api/routers/__init__.py
nodes.summary: Routers package init. Empty or minimal re-exports.

nodes.name: backend/core/__init__.py
nodes.summary: Core package init. May export settings instance or security utilities.

nodes.name: backend/db/__init__.py
nodes.summary: DB package init. Empty or minimal re-exports.

nodes.name: backend/models/__init__.py
nodes.summary: Models package init. Re-exports all ORM model classes for convenience.

nodes.name: cic.py
nodes.summary: SQLAlchemy ORM model for CICRecord, representing simulated third-party credit bureau (CIC) records keyed by CCCD (12-digit national ID). Stores credit scores, active loan summaries, delinquency flags, and full loan history JSON.

nodes.name: personal_info.py
nodes.summary: SQLAlchemy ORM model for PersonalInfo, storing customer identity details (ID card, phone, address, bank account, document URLs) linked one-to-one with a LoanApplication and many-to-one with a User.

nodes.name: user.py
nodes.summary: SQLAlchemy ORM model for User, holding authentication credentials, profile fields (CCCD, full_name, phone, address), role, and relationships to LoanApplication and ChatSession.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Lazy-import package init for the RAG module; exposes a curated public API (build_user_context, get_chain, get_retriever, invoke, load_memory, classify_intent, check_input/output, build_personalization, etc.) via __getattr__ to avoid circular imports at startup.

nodes.name: chain.py
nodes.summary: Main RAG pipeline orchestrator: runs input guardrail → intent routing → query rewriting → hybrid retrieval → personalization → LLM call (OpenRouter via LangChain LCEL) → output guardrail, returning answer, source documents, and intent.

nodes.name: chunking.py
nodes.summary: Markdown/FAQ-structure-aware semantic chunker that splits knowledge-base documents into parent sections and child chunks (with overlap), enriches metadata (source_type, document_title, section_title, parent_id), and supports parent-document retrieval expansion.

nodes.name: config.py
nodes.summary: Thin bridge that reads RAG-specific settings from core.config.settings and re-exports them as module-level constants (LLM_MODEL, EMBEDDING_MODEL, BM25_SPARSE_MODEL, Qdrant URL/key/collection, reranker params, TOP_K, etc.).

nodes.name: context_builder.py
nodes.summary: Assembles a structured 4-block RAG context string (form data, ML prediction, derived advisory analysis, data quality) from a user's latest LoanApplication ORM record for injection into the LLM system prompt.

nodes.name: eval_dataset.py
nodes.summary: Provides helpers to load and validate a JSON evaluation dataset for RAG testing, enforcing required fields and dataset size constraints (30-50 cases).

nodes.name: eval_metrics.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic (no-LLM) RAG evaluation metrics: phrase-presence scoring for faithfulness and context precision, per-case scoring, group/run summarization, and regression detection via configurable deltas.

nodes.name: eval_runner.py
nodes.summary: CLI script that loads an eval dataset, runs each case through the RAG chain (or a custom invoke function), scores results using eval_metrics, and outputs a JSON report with regression detection.

nodes.name: exceptions.py
nodes.summary: Defines the RAG exception hierarchy: RAGError (base), RetrievalError (Qdrant/embedding failure), LLMError (OpenRouter failure), and RAGTimeoutError (upstream timeout).

nodes.name: guardrails.py
nodes.summary: Input and output safety guardrails: input checks for message length, prompt injection, and PII probing; output checks for internal data leakage, approval promises (soft-fix with disclaimer), and length capping.

nodes.name: ingest.py
nodes.summary: CLI ingestion script that loads Markdown knowledge-base files from rag/knowledge/ and docs/data_dictionary/, semantically chunks them, and upserts hybrid (dense + BM25 sparse) vectors into Qdrant; supports --dry-run and --recreate flags.

nodes.name: faq.md
nodes.summary: FAQ knowledge-base document (302 lines) containing Q&A pairs covering common customer questions about loan applications, risk scores, DTI, credit scores, and CreditIntel policies; ingested into Qdrant for RAG retrieval.

nodes.name: policy.md
nodes.summary: Policy knowledge-base document (293 lines) describing CreditIntel's loan approval policies, state-machine transitions, risk-level thresholds, and process guidelines; ingested into Qdrant for RAG retrieval.

nodes.name: memory.py
nodes.summary: Token-aware conversation memory with a sliding-window of recent turns and a lazy summary buffer for older turns; persists summaries to PostgreSQL ChatSession and converts ChatMessage rows to LangChain message objects.

nodes.name: personalizer.py
nodes.summary: Builds PersonalizationContext from a user profile and latest application status, mapping each loan status to a specific tone/greeting instruction; also provides per-intent LLM instruction strings.

nodes.name: prompts.py
nodes.summary: Defines the LangChain ChatPromptTemplate (chat_prompt) for the CreditIntel RAG assistant: a Vietnamese-language system template with slots for personalization, intent instructions, user context, conversation summary, retrieved documents, and chat history.

nodes.name: query_rewriter.py
nodes.summary: Rewrites a user's follow-up question into a standalone retrieval query using an LLM, incorporating conversation history and summary context; falls back to the original question on failure or when no prior context exists.

nodes.name: reranker.py
nodes.summary: Lazy-loading cross-encoder reranker singleton (jina-reranker-v2-base-multilingual via fastembed) that scores and re-sorts candidate documents by query relevance; disabled when rag_reranker_enabled=False.

nodes.name: retriever.py
nodes.summary: Hybrid Qdrant retriever stack (dense OpenAI embeddings + BM25 sparse via FastEmbedSparse) wrapped in ParentDocumentRetriever (child to parent expansion) and RerankedRetriever (cross-encoder re-scoring); includes a SelfHealingHybridRetriever for Qdrant offline recovery.

nodes.name: router.py
nodes.summary: Intent classifier that first applies regex keyword fast-paths (greeting, risk, policy, off-topic) then falls back to an LLM call to classify user messages into one of six intents, determining whether Qdrant retrieval is needed.

tour.title: Project Overview & Conventions
tour.description: Start here. The README describes CreditIntel as a full-stack loan management and risk-assessment system; CLAUDE.md captures the architecture, layering rules, and the all-important 0.4 auto-reject threshold and Bronze→Silver→Gold data flow.

tour.title: Data Foundation: the ETL Pipeline
tour.description: Everything downstream depends on features built here. pipeline.py orchestrates Bronze→Silver→Gold on DuckDB; the silver transform joins six raw Home Credit tables, and the gold transform engineers the 35 modeling features written to gold.hc_features_v2.

tour.title: Training the Risk Models
tour.description: The two offline models that power inference. retrain_customer_model.py trains the LightGBM v4 risk model (customer_risk_model.pkl); train_scorecard.py trains the LR scorecard that maps default probability to a FICO-style 300–850 score.

tour.title: Transactional Database Schema
tour.description: Where applications live at runtime. init_app.sql defines the PostgreSQL tables (UUID PKs, JSONB feature snapshots, ML output columns); the LoanApplication ORM model mirrors that schema and carries the status enum that drives the state machine.

tour.title: Backend Entry Point
tour.description: The FastAPI app: CORS, the six mounted routers, the reranker pre-warm on startup, and the /health endpoint. This is where every API request begins.

tour.title: The Loan Application State Machine
tour.description: The core domain logic. The applications router stays thin and delegates to application_service, which runs the ML prediction and sets AUTO_REJECTED (default probability > 0.4) or PENDING_REVIEW — the heart of the system.

tour.title: ML Inference at Submission
tour.description: How a raw application becomes a risk score. model_feature_builder assembles the ordered 35-feature vector (imputing defaults), and ml_service loads the LightGBM pkl and returns default probability, risk level, and a binary-search loan suggestion.

tour.title: The Credit Scorecard
tour.description: A parallel, explainable score. credit_score_service loads the LR scorecard artifact and computes the FICO-style 300–850 score with per-feature contributions, surfaced to both customer and admin.

tour.title: RAG Chatbot Orchestration
tour.description: The conversational layer. chat_service rate-limits, ensures an ML prediction exists, detects loan re-application intent, and invokes the LangChain chain — which routes intent, rewrites the query, retrieves, personalizes, and calls the LLM.

tour.title: RAG Retrieval & Context
tour.description: What grounds the chatbot's answers. retriever.py is the hybrid Qdrant stack (dense + BM25, parent-document expansion, cross-encoder rerank); context_builder assembles the 4-block application context injected into the prompt.

tour.title: Frontend Bootstrap & API Layer
tour.description: How the UI is wired. App.jsx defines all customer/admin routes behind guards; services/api.js is the single Axios instance with the JWT interceptor through which every HTTP call flows.

tour.title: Customer Loan Application Flow
tour.description: Bringing it together from the user's side. The Apply page collects data, auto-fetches CIC, evaluates the loan, and on AUTO_REJECTED triggers the RAG advisor; the LoanAdjustmentActionCard renders the LLM-suggested safer terms for resubmission.
